messages:
sasha: Heads up — p99 is weird on /v1/generate in the endpoint breakdown after yesterday's routing policy change. p50/p95 look fine, p99 jumps during bursts.

mike: I saw that too. quick correlate with traces: a bunch of requests fell back to the slow variant (quantized->fp16) at ~14:36. KV cache miss rate spiked at the same timestamps.

elin: Are those fallbacks from routing weight shifts or quota enforcement?

mike: Looks like weight shift (canary increased from 10% -> 30% around 14:30). fallback was triggered because the canary pool didn't have warmed kv caches for long contexts.

jordan: So dashboard shows endpoint p99 changing, but it's not obvious whether the tail is from routing or from cold kvcache. We need provenance surfaced. :thinking:

paul: Agree. Users keep asking why p99 jumps and the UI just shows a single line. We should annotate the latency panes with sample source breakdown (route variant, cache-hit/miss, fallback-reason).

sasha: Proposal: add a lightweight telemetry attribute on each request called `sample_origin_hint` with values like `primary`, `fallback`, `canary`, `quota_fallback`. Keep it optional and low-cardinality. Then in the console we can show a stacked ribbon for p50/p95/p99 indicating what percentage of tail came from each origin.

elin: Love the idea. Implementation note: we already record route and model_variant in logs, but join costs are nontrivial for dashboards. If we emit the hint into the metrics pipeline as a tag at emission time it's cheap to roll up.

mike: To be concrete, telemetry line could include: `origin_hint=fallback,kvcache=miss,route=eu-1` so rollups can be by `origin_hint` without heavy joins.

jordan: Can we also include `route_weight_at_request`? That would help explain canary-induced effects when weight changes during rollouts. Maybe as `route_weight_pct=30`.

elin: I'd prefer keeping numeric fields out of rollup tags to avoid cardinality explosion. One idea: bucket route weight into `low/medium/high` at decision time, e.g., `weight_bucket=low` for <=10, `medium` 10-50, `high` >50. That stays low-cardinality and useful.

paul: UX suggestion: toggle in the console to switch the percentile view to "by origin_hint". Default stays as-is, but add a small legend and hover text that links to a tiny explainer.

sasha: Also need to ensure quota fallbacks are clearly labeled. `quota_fallback` should indicate requests that were rerouted due to credit exhaustion vs typical model fallback.

mike: Quick diagnostic query I used: ```sql
-- estimate p99 by origin_hint for last hour
SELECT origin_hint, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) as p99_ms
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY origin_hint;
```

elin: That helps. If we add the tag at emission time we can get this exact query without joins. I'll open a small change to the emitter to include `origin_hint` computed from routing outcome and cache flags.

jordan: Can someone own the console toggle + legend? Ideally it should be visible in the endpoint detail page and in the rollouts gating UI.

paul: I can mock a tiny ribbon component this afternoon and post screenshots. Would be ~1 day of frontend work + backend metric exposure.

sasha: Action items: elin — PR to add `origin_hint` and `weight_bucket` to emitted metrics (small flag), mike — instrument a quick dashboard query and add example to runbook, paul — frontend mock + hover copy, j jordan — check whether any billing/quotas ingestion is impacted.

elin: I'll aim to have the emitter PR up by EOD tomorrow. Putting `origin_hint` values: [primary, canary, fallback, quota_fallback].

mike: One more caveat: when requests fan out (batching across pools) we need a deterministic rule for the hint—use the first attempted route or the slowest variant winner? Recommend: set hint to 'slowest_outcome' so the tail attribution matches user-facing latency.

sasha: Good call. Document that in the spec. Also add note for canary rollouts: when bumping weight, do a short-lived cache-warm phase to avoid artificial p99 inflation. Could be as small as synthetic warm requests.

paul: Screenshot mock posted: https://internal.mock/screens/latency-ribbon.png (placeholder). Hover text: "Shows what percent of this percentile was contributed by each request origin (canary/fallback/primary/quota)."

jordan: Nice. If we ship this, it should clear up a lot of support noise. Also reduces need for ad-hoc trace investigations.

sasha: Ok locking in owners. @elin you'll add an opt-in emitter flag for one week so we can validate. After we measure, flip to default-on. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued by elin for branch `emit-origin-hint` to staging at 2026-03-22T09:12:00Z

mike: I'll run the SQL query after staging data lands and post numbers.

sasha: Great, close the loop here once staging shows expected tags and then we'll plan a tiny front-end rollout.
